name: WAVE reusable workflow (workflow_call)
description: A reusable workflow invoked by other workflows via workflow_call. Pre-wired to the WAVE Workflow Authoring Standard — the counterintuitive rule: NO concurrency block here, because cancel-in-progress in a called workflow fires across every caller and can cancel an unrelated repo's run. The caller owns concurrency. Full rules: wave-foundation/rules/workflow-authoring.md.
